excerpt: Three weeks to the US election. The polls say coin flip, 50-50 inside the margin of error, as they've said for months. Prediction markets say something else: Polymarket has drifted to roughly 60-40 for Trump, hundreds of millions in cumulative volume behind it. So the discourse picked its fighter: "a whale is manipulating the odds". Maybe. It's the wrong question. The right question is what each number actually measures.
title: Markets don't lie, they leak
